newsitem.title: USA: February retail sales strong after big January jump.
newsitem.headline: February retail sales strong after big January jump.

text.p: Sales by retail stores rose briskly in February after the strongest surge in nearly a year during January, the Commerce Department said on Thursday, reflecting robust consumer demand at the beginning of 1997.

Total retail sales increased 0.8 percent last month to a seasonally adjusted $213.18 billion after a sharply revised 1.5 percent jump in January -- more than double the previuously reported 0.6 percent pickup in January sales.
